Chocolate Guinness Cake
by Nigella. Featured in FEAST
Print me
Introduction
"This cake is magnificent in its damp blackness."
For US measures and ingredient names, use the toggle at the top of the ingredients list.
Photo by James Merrell
Share or save this
Ingredients
Yields: about 12 slices
Metric U.S.
For the Cake
250 millilitres Guinness
250 grams unsalted butter
75 grams cocoa powder
400 grams caster sugar
150 millilitres sour cream
2 large eggs
2½ teaspoons vanilla extract
275 grams plain flour
2½ teaspoons bicarbonate of soda
For the Topping
300 grams cream cheese
150 grams icing sugar
2 teaspoons cornflour
125 millilitres double cream (or whipping cream)
For the Cake
1 cup Guinness
2 sticks plus 2 tablespoons unsalted butter
¾ cup unsweetened cocoa
2 cups granulated sugar
⅔ cup sour cream
2 large eggs
2½ teaspoons vanilla extract
2 cups all-purpose flour
2½ teaspoons baking soda
For the Topping
8 ounces cream cheese
1¼ cups confectioners' sugar
2 teaspoons cornstarch
½ cup heavy cream (or whipping cream)

5. If using double cream, add it and beat until you have…
6. Ice the top of the black cake so that it resembles…
